requirements.REQ-TIECAP-23: - **server now**: the server's UTC clock, read once when the HTTP request is handled; used only for the as_of bound (REQ-TIECAP-23) and for an absent as_of.
requirements.REQ-TIECAP-8: - **Usable capacity**: an entry that is present, valid (REQ-TIECAP-8), `quality == "GOOD"` and `age ≤ 20 s` (Q-SPEC-2).
requirements.REQ-TIECAP-1: | REQ-TIECAP-1 | `backend/app/models.py` shall define a Pydantic model `TieCapacity` with required fields `kw: float` (kW, same basis as `Section.load_kw`), `timestamp` (strict timezone-aware ISO-8601 datetime) and `quality: str`, and shall reject unknown fields. Validation shall reject: `kw` that is not a JSON number (string, bool, null); `timestamp` that is a non-ISO-8601 string, a JSON number, null or timezone-naive; `quality` that is not a string. It shall **not** range-check `kw` (NaN, ±Infinity and negative numbers pass validation so the planner flags them CAPACITY_INVALID, REQ-TIECAP-8) and shall not compare `timestamp` with any clock (Q-SPEC-3, Q-SPEC-9, Q-SPEC-13). | JSON / Python values → `TieCapacity` or validation error | Missing, unknown or wrongly typed field → validation error; over HTTP → 422 for the whole request (REQ-TIECAP-13). | Test: model unit tests for each accept/reject class (`"yesterday"`, `1790000000`, `"2026-10-15T22:00:00"` naive, `"2000"`, `true`, extra field → reject; `NaN`, `-1.0`, `+02:00` offset → accept). Inspection of `models.py`. | — |

requirements.REQ-TIECAP-2: | REQ-TIECAP-2 | `flisr.build_plan` shall accept `tie_capacity: dict[str, TieCapacity] \| None` keyed by tie switch mRID, and `as_of: datetime \| None`. When `as_of` is None it shall use the UTC now read once at the start of the call. A timezone-aware `as_of` with any offset shall be used as the same instant. A timezone-naive `as_of` shall make `build_plan` raise and return no plan (Q-SPEC-12(a): a malformed time reference yields no plan at all). `build_plan` itself shall not bound `as_of` against the clock; that bound is a request-validation rule (REQ-TIECAP-23), and `api.py` is the only production caller. | feeder, lockout mRID, tie_capacity, as_of → `RestorationPlan` | `tie_capacity` None or `{}` → every candidate tie is CAPACITY_UNKNOWN (REQ-TIECAP-5). Naive `as_of` → raise, no plan. | Test with an injected `as_of` (UTC and `+02:00` give identical plans; naive raises); inspection. | — |

requirements.REQ-TIECAP-3: | REQ-TIECAP-3 | For a candidate tie with usable capacity C, `build_plan` shall emit a `close` restoration step for that tie **if and only if** `L ≤ C + 0.5 kW`. | L, C → close step present / absent | C not usable → REQ-TIECAP-5..8; never closed. | Test against an independent closed-form oracle: QA computes L with its own BFS over the test topology (not `network.load_on_nodes` or `_nodes_restored_by`) and evaluates `L_oracle ≤ C + 0.5`. Shipped-model boundary (L = 1490 kW): C = 1490.0 closes; C = 1489.5 closes (L = C + τ); C = 1489.4 blocked CAPACITY_EXCEEDED. Tolerance 0.5 kW engineering units; per-unit waived (Q-SPEC-4). | — |
